name: amber-linen-fashion-portrait
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and studio portrait editorial

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic medium chest-up portrait of one confident adult individual in a beige linen shirt against a soft amber gradient.
prompt.main_subject: One adult individual with natural skin texture, relaxed pose, slight head tilt, and direct eye contact, wearing a beige linen shirt with minimal accessories.
composition_elements: Relaxed posture and slight head tilt.
Linen weave and natural facial texture remain visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm 3800K light from above with a glowing halo rim light around the hair, soft controlled shadows, and quiet editorial warmth.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic 8K editorial fashion photography, shallow depth of field, sharp facial focus, realistic linen texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic medium chest-up editorial portrait of a confident adult individual in a beige linen shirt, centered against a soft amber gradient background. Relaxed pose with slight head tilt and direct eye contact. Warm 3800K lighting from above with a glowing halo rim light around the hair. Shallow depth of field, natural skin textures, 8K resolution, editorial fashion aesthetic, minimal accessories, no text, no watermark.

assets.name: amber-linen-fashion-portrait.jpg

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required adult reference. Preserve identity, linen shirt, head tilt, amber gradient, 3800K lighting, halo rim light, and minimal accessories. Replace only with an equivalent adult identity reference; no celebrity likeness, logos, or typography.
